description:
Eastside is a leading youth arts charity that empowers young people aged 5-25 years facing the most serious disadvantage across Hackney, London and the UK.  In 2023/24 Eastside delivered 2420 creative workshops empowering 62,999 young people across the UK.  We have owned and occupied our building on the Hackney Road for 20 years and have been delivering services to young people for over 30 years.

Eastside is fortunate to have received a grant from Hackney Council under the Affordable Workspace Grant scheme to modernise our building and create more workspace within.  Alongside this, Eastside wishes to modernise and improve the external side and front aspects of our building and we therefore through this planning application propose to do the following:

1. Add a new Fascia Sign (Building Number) to the middle elevation (between the front and side elevations) using more modern materials and font to meet company brand guidelines.
2. Add an illuminated new Fascia Sign (Company Name) lit from above applied to the front elevation using more modern materials and font to meet company brand guidelines.
3. Add an illuminated Projection sign to the front elevation with our name and logo combined within it to meet company brand guidelines.
4.  Add a small welcome sign to the side elevation of our building to improve accessibility and improve way finding.
5. Repair areas of damaged brickwork and repaint the front and side elevations of the building with a soft blue colour replacing the outdated existing purple colour.
6. Replace Eastside front doors - Due to the excessive height of the building's front doors and their weight, they have warped and become rotten over time. We therefore need to remove these doors and install smaller and lighter doors to ensure long term security and sustainability.

The combination of the above improvements along with the interior improvements Eastside is delivering, will create a much more attractive building on the Hackney Road befitting of the highest quality work that Eastside delivers annually to its many thousands of young beneficiaries across Hackney, London and the UK.  We are thankful to the planning team for its swift appraisal of our planning application as we are working with Hackney council to deliver this project to meet their approaching funding deadlines (end of March 2025).
subdivision_of_building:
These proposals apply to:
1) the front elevation (East facing) of Eastside's building frontage (Suite 16, Perseverance Works, 37 Hackney Road) facing the Hackney road where we will apply the new lettering and projection sign as well as replacing the front doors.  
2) the middle elevation (between the front elevation and side elevation) where we will apply the new building numbering
3) The small welcome sign will be applied to the side elevation (South facing wall) adjacent to the side entrance of the building facing the driveway entrance into Perseverance Works as you exit the Hackney Road.
Both front, middle and side elevations will be repainted with the soft blue colour.
decision_conditions: 1. No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.2. No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to(a)endanger persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);(b)obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or(c)hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.3. Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.4. Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.5. Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.REASON: To safeguard amenity and public safety.
